name: KiroFactoryFactory
description: Three loops that build this app from feature plans: a trigger splits plans in plans/factory-ready into work items, a scaled developer cluster implements them in their own worktrees, and a version-control loop commits and merges. Point it at a checkout of sample-ai-factory.

parameters.name: ready
parameters.description: Folder of feature plans waiting to be built, one feature-<name>-plan.md each.

loops.name: factory-feature-trigger
loops.prompt:
if @ready holds a feature-<name>-plan.md we want to read the markdown and move it into running to claim it. We then take all the ideas in the markdown and each that represents a concise feature is moved onto @output to be picked up by the development loop. Do not split plans unless absolutely necessary, a single loop should implement the full single plan. 

Create a little html page in your loop folder with a kanban view of the three folders factory-ready running and factory-done. Keep it updated.

loops.name: version control
loops.prompt: if @input seem sane by the looks of it, git commit. If the loops worked in worktrees merge their branches back into the branch @project is currently on

loops.name: developer-loop
loops.prompt: read @input and start implementing it. Once done with the implementation push it into plans/factory-done and add your completion note at the top of it. Finally hand the topic to @output for version control loop.
